name: Pixcoin
description: Gold Coins commonly found throughout Planarcadia. They can be exchanged for items, but there is a weekly cap on how many you can obtain.
story:
A currency pieced together from fragmented Wishpower. It represents the stereotypical impression of intelligent lifeforms about "wealth."

"If I collect millions of Pixcoins, can I make a fortune too?"
"Why don't you extract all the ions from the waters of Ahatopia?"
